<thought>Since the provided template (ID 12345) cannot be applied due to a mismatch in expected reactant count, I will search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that specifically breaks an S‑Cl bond and forms an N‑S bond (the sulfonamide formation). This should yield a template that can be applied to the target molecule to generate the amine and sulfonyl chloride precursors.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O",
    "bonds_broken": ["S-Cl"],
    "bonds_formed": ["N-S"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
